notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.notes:
Fixed a map loading issue

Exiting the tutorial right after starting it was causing the copter height to remain fixed

Slight tweaks to the map textures

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 - Tutorial rework
notes.notes:
Overhaul of the tutorial system to interactively progress through a flight course, more content of this type to come to help with the steep learning curve. 

Please let me know what you think, its super easy to send suggestions from the in-game feedback form.



Thank you and have fun!

Casey

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Flight course attacker (Lvl 7) wasn't firing bullets

Flight course ghosts running into obstacles caused reset

Updated flight course terrain textures

Dropped starter gun damage from 125 to 75

Collectables now prevent instant pickup on drop (.25s delay)

Many item passive buffs were increased

Fixed an edge case where the last wave didn't end after killing the boss

Increased to boss health

Fixed a bug with picked up crates

Fixed a bug where the boss HP bar displayed incorrectly until the first damage
